newsitem.title: USA: Vital sees $90 million in FY96 sales.
newsitem.headline: Vital sees $90 million in FY96 sales.

text.p: Vital Signs Inc said on Monday that it anticipated net sales of $90 million in fiscal 1996 compared to revenues of $89.6 million in fiscal 1995.

The company, which designs, manufactures and markets single-use products for anesthesia and critical care, also said it expected sales from new products to add more than $10 million to top line sales growth in fiscal 1997.
Two new products expected to add to fiscal 1997 sales were Vital's Vasceze catheter flush device and its Isocath closed suction device, it said.

Competitive pressures in the marketplace, customer acceptance of the products, manufacturing delays and the effect of unanticipated manufacturing delays were cited by the company as possible factors that could hurt this forecast.
